# `adt codegen`

Generate code from ADT discovery data

```bash
adt codegen [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                 | Description                                         |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt codegen contracts` | Generate type-safe contracts from SAP ADT discovery |

## `adt codegen contracts`

Generate type-safe contracts from SAP ADT discovery

```bash
adt codegen contracts [options]
```

**Options**

| Option               | Description                                                 | Default |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--discovery <file>` | Path to discovery XML file (fetched from SAP if not exists) |         |
| `--output <dir>`     | Output directory for generated contracts                    |         |
| `--docs <dir>`       | Output directory for documentation                          |         |
| `--fetch`            | Force fetch discovery from SAP (even if cached)             |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
